subject: Offer sign-off request: rapid senior inference hire — band override
messages_1_subject: Candidate offer: Evan Mirza — quick-accept window; comp proposal attached
messages_1_body:
Hi Neha / Marissa / Lauren,

Quick note: candidate Evan Mirza (final on-site yesterday) has multiple offers and needs an accept/decline within 72 hours. He flagged Redwood as his top choice but asked for a slightly higher base to match counteroffers. We discussed a narrow band override for IC4 to secure him.

Attached: resume and proposed comp spreadsheet (shows base, eq, signing bonus scenario). Recruiting recommends: base $190k + $25k signing bonus + standard equity (0.20%). That sits slightly above our published IC4 midpoint but within the hiring manager's request.

Can you confirm whether People Ops can sign a one-time band override for this hire and whether Finance needs to greenlight aSigning bonus? If we can get sign-off today we will push the DocuSign link and try to close within 48h.

Thanks,
Priya (for EdgeAI Recruiting)
---
EdgeAI Recruiting
recruiting@edgeai.com
+1 415-555-0182
messages_2_subject: Re: Candidate offer: Evan Mirza — quick-accept window; comp proposal attached
messages_2_body:
Thanks Priya — looping in Marissa (People Ops) and Marcus (Hiring Manager) for comp approval and Jonas for a quick finance sanity check.

Marcus: can you confirm this role's top-of-band budget and business justification for the override? Please call out any revenue/roadmap impact that makes this hire time-sensitive.

Marissa: if we approve, will People Ops handle a one-time signing bonus and do we need a formal exception doc?

I want the approval thread to explicitly state: final base, signing bonus, equity % and note if we require an additional approval from Finance. If we can get this finalized today, I will send the offer and mark the candidate as priority.

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Senior Recruiter, Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Ext: 6221
messages_3_subject: Re: Candidate offer: Evan Mirza — quick-accept window; comp proposal attached
messages_3_body:
Neha — thanks. Evan's background maps straight to the latency/quantization work we need for the serving runtime; the product timeline is impacted if we miss Q1 deliverables without this hire. Given the candidate's counteroffer and his demonstrated domain expertise, I'm comfortable recommending a one-time band override.

Proposal (final):
- Title: Senior Inference Engineer (IC4)
- Base: $195,000
- Signing bonus: $25,000 (one-time, payable within first payroll cycle)
- Equity: 0.22% standard grant for IC4

Business justification: shortfall on quant-optimizations roadmap, high ramp potential, and immediate ability to unblock two critical integration sprints.

Please proceed with People Ops if Marissa confirms the exception process. Lauren — tagging you to confirm manager-level approval for this range from a compensation sanity perspective. Happy to hop on a 15-min call if helpful.

Best,
Marcus Lin
Director, Serving Runtime
marcus_lin@redwood.com
messages_4_subject: Re: Candidate offer: Evan Mirza — quick-accept window; comp proposal attached
messages_4_body:
All — approved. People Ops will accept the one-time signing bonus and the base at $195k for IC4 as a band override. Conditions:
1) Exception memo filed (I attached the short form)
2) Manager confirms start date and hiring plan within 2 weeks
3) Finance (Jonas) gave verbal OK; will formalize in the exception memo.

I've attached the offer template for IC4 and generated a DocuSign envelope. Links: Drive offer pkg + DocuSign link (see related_links).

Neha, please send the DocuSign and mark candidate priority. Copy me on the offer email.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Head of People Operations
marissa_cole@redwood.com
Attachment: offer-template-IC4.docx; exception-memo-evan-mirza.pdf
